services.title: Leak Repair & Drip Fixes
services.desc: Dripping faucets, running toilets, and the leaks you can hear but can't find. Diagnosed and fixed in one visit, most of the time.

services.title: Water Heater Install & Repair
services.desc: Tank and tankless, gas and electric. Same-day install on most stock units when yours finally gives out.

services.title: Repiping
services.desc: Old galvanized or failing polybutylene swapped for copper or PEX, room by room or whole-house.

services.title: Drain & Sewer Cleaning
services.desc: Camera inspection before we quote anything — so you know what's actually down there before we touch it.

services.title: Fixture Installs
services.desc: Faucets, toilets, garbage disposals, tub and shower valves. Bring your own fixture or we'll spec one.

services.title: Emergency Calls
services.desc: Burst pipe at 2am doesn't wait for business hours. Neither do we — see the emergency line below.

owner.name: Nate Colby
owner.bio: Nate Colby apprenticed under a Boise plumbing outfit for six years before going out on his own in 2013 with a van and a pager. Cascade & Copper is still small on purpose — Nate runs most calls himself, quotes the job before touching a wrench, and answers the emergency line personally more nights than not. No dispatch fee games, no upsell script, just the actual fix and the actual price.

faq.q: How fast can you get here for an emergency?
faq.a: Most Treasure Valley addresses inside an hour, day or night. Call the emergency line directly — it rings to a phone, not a call center.

faq.q: Do you charge extra for after-hours calls?
faq.a: A modest after-hours trip fee applies outside 7am–7pm, quoted before you commit. No mystery surcharge on the invoice.
Yes — 90 days on workmanship for standard repairs, longer on major installs. Parts carry the manufacturer's own warranty.
The service call fee ($89) covers diagnosis and a written quote, and it's waived entirely if you book the repair on the spot.
